title: RTMPT: Add Enhanced RTMP Multitrack Support
description: This adds support for Enhanced RTMP Multitrack Audio & Video based on the newest [Enhanced RTMP v2 Specification](https://veovera.org/docs/enhanced/enhanced-rtmp-v2).


@martin.r.mathieson, there is no check of hf description if it is very similar (or part of the name ?) 
for this dissector it is the RTMPT folllowing with name stuff

We could definitely do more to clean up long text strings that don't add any extra information.  In the case of this dissector, where there are 2 different protocols to distinguish between, I'm not sure what the right answer is.

Don't want to sidetrack this MR, but I found a surprising number of items where the label is shorter than the blurb.  In some cases, it gives different information, but sometimes is literally a subset of the words from the label.  I did start to add a check for re-ordering/capitalizing, and found these:

epan/dissectors/packet-afp.c hf_afp_server_flag_notify label="Support server notifications" blurb="Server support notifications" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-afp.c hf_afp_server_flag_reconnect label="Support server reconnect" blurb="Server support reconnect" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-ansi_map.c hf_ansi_map_cdmachanneldata_lc_mask_b6 label="Long Code Mask (byte 6) MSB" blurb="Long Code Mask MSB (byte 6)" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-dec-dnart.c hf_dec_rt_services label="Requested services" blurb="Services requested" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-isns.c hf_isns_entity_next_index label="Entity Next Index" blurb="Next Entity Index" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-ldp.c hf_ldp_tlv_sess_fr_len label="Number of DLCI bits" blurb="DLCI Number of bits" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-ldp.c hf_ldp_tlv_fr_label_len label="Number of DLCI bits" blurb="DLCI Number of bits" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-netflow.c hf_pie_ixia_udpAppResponseTime label="UDP Average Application Response Time (us)" blurb="Average UDP Application Response Time (us)" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-u3v.c hf_u3v_bootstrap_Timestamp_Latch label="Latch Timestamp" blurb="Timestamp Latch" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-uma.c hf_uma_urr_gmsi label="GMSI, GAN Mode Support Indicator" blurb="GMSI, GAN Mode Support Indicator" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!

epan/dissectors/packet-wassp.c hf_cos_rateid label="COS In&Out Rate Id" blurb="Cos In&Out Rate Id" - Blurb is just label re-ordered!!!
Yes, no good idea to hack this MR, may be open an issue
